title: Listen and Choose a Response — Getting Around Town

questions.stem: How much is a monthly bus pass these days?

options.A: The bus stops every fifteen minutes.
options.B: It went up recently, so check the transit website.
options.C: Yes, I passed my driving test.
options.D: I usually sit near the back.

questions.explanation: The question asks about price; saying it changed and pointing to the website is an appropriate indirect answer. 'Passed' only sounds like 'pass', and the others ignore the cost.
questions.speaker: f4
